title_en: #276 - The Stablecoin Revolution: Exploring the Future of Digital Dollars with First Digital Group CEO Vincent Chok
title_zh: 稳定币革命：数字美元的未来
subtitle_zh: First Digital Group CEO Vincent Chok 与 CSLM Digital Asset Acquisition Corp III 联席 CEO Vikas Mittal，谈稳定币的商业模式、储备结构、利率顺风，以及为什么 AI 智能体也需要稳定币。
description: #276 - The Stablecoin Revolution: Exploring the Future of Digital Dollars with First Digital Group CEO Vincent Chok

turns.en: Welcome investors to the Absolute Return podcast, your source for stock market analysis, global macro musings, and hedge fund investment strategies. turns.en: This episode is brought to you by Accelerate Financial Technologies. Accelerate because performance matters. Find out more at AccelerateCheers.com. Hey everybody, welcome to the Absolute Return podcast. On today's show, we welcome special guests, first digital group CEO Vincent Chuck.
